reviews.review: this is how any third person shooter should be made, it is completly badass and i highly recremend thos who LOVE the Warhammer series.

Ecellent game!
Once you get a hammer you won't want to shoot anyone again, not when you can hammer them 8)

Ever wanted to be a Space Marine? No, not one of those weakling Blizzard knock-offs from Starcraft... a true Angel of Death? Well this is the game for you!

Relic Entertainment, as usual, does a fantastic job here. They know the Grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe very well, and have crafted the game with the love and care of the most ardent 40K fanboy. And boy oh boy, have they delievered for the fanboys (and newcomers!) here. 

Gameplay can be sumed up basically as a 3rd person action melee/shooter hybrid. Built on the same engine as the Darksiders games, think of that game, crossed with Relics superb RTS Dawn of War 2, and you have an idea of what Warhammer 40,000 Space Marine is like.

There is alot of fun to be had with this title. With a great Singleplayer Campaign, PvP Multiplayer and Co-Op Horde Multiplayer modes to try out, it is good value for money too. The only real criticism I can lay on it is the lack of dedicated servers for the multiplayer, which can sometimes result in a bit of lag in some matchups.

Finally, if you have previously read any reviews by critics comparing Space Marine with Gears of War, then you can safely regard those critics as fools from now on. Because, apart from being in 3rd person and including chainswords, there are very little similarities. Also, anyone claiming this game has stolen its chainsaw concept from GoW, will be summarily executed for heresy. (Warhammer 40K has had chainsaws for over 25 years!)

To sum up, this is a must buy for Warhammer fans, and a great entry point for everyone else not yet acquainted with the incredible setting that is Warhammer 40,000.
Way too few people play this game. The Online community is too small! :D
Well worth playing. Would highly recommend it.
